zero_shortcut.note: Looks like a branch simplification in b58encode_int; drops the default_one guard, so b58encode(b'') returns b'1' and leading-zero inputs gain a digit.

latin1_scrub.note: Claims latin-1 is a cheaper codec than ascii for str input; non-ASCII str input is now silently accepted instead of raising UnicodeEncodeError. Upstream tests only pass ASCII strings.

no_map_cache.note: Presented as removing lru_cache hashing overhead; actually rebuilds the decode map on every call, so decode does more work.
